technology_name: IoT-Based Red Palm Weevil Detection System (ARPWD)
institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Difficulty in early detection of Red Palm Weevil infestation
description: ARPWD is an IoT-based acoustic detection system that identifies sounds and vibrations associated with Red Palm Weevil activity. The system communicates alerts through LoRaWAN and web-based monitoring platforms to support pest management.
applications:
Coconut, date palm, and oil palm plantation enterprises
Agricultural IoT and precision farming technology companies
Pest monitoring and crop protection service providers
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and plantation grower cooperatives
Government agriculture departments and integrated pest management programs
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Robotics, Automation & Drones
